metadata.description: Claude Code plugins for professional development workflows and GitHub integration

plugins.name: sdlc-core
plugins.description: Core SDLC foundations: Marvin persona output style, memory protocol, shared conventions

plugins.name: sdlc-architecture
plugins.description: Architecture Decision Records and ARCHITECTURE.md synthesis (events/projection pattern)

plugins.name: sdlc-event-modeling
plugins.description: Event Modeling (Adam Dymitruk's methodology) for event-sourced systems. Based on Martin Dilger's book.

plugins.name: sdlc-planning
plugins.description: Story planning with three-perspective review (business, technical, UX)

plugins.name: sdlc-tdd
plugins.description: Test-Driven Development workflow with Red/Green/Refactor cycle and domain modeling

plugins.name: github-issues
plugins.description: Comprehensive GitHub issue management with sub-issues, blocking relationships, and linked branches

plugins.name: github-projects
plugins.description: GitHub Projects V2 Kanban board management with status/priority workflows

plugins.name: marvin-sdlc
plugins.description: [DEPRECATED] Use sdlc-core + sdlc-* plugins instead. Legacy monolithic SDLC plugin.
plugins.deprecationMessage: This plugin has been split into modular components: sdlc-core, sdlc-architecture, sdlc-event-modeling, sdlc-planning, sdlc-tdd. Please migrate to the new plugins.
